working_tree_note: The tested source file matches source_commit; this evidence packet and documentation were added afterward.
case: ClickHouse Map(UInt8, Array(Tuple(String, Nullable(UInt128)))) keeps its native nested contract and refuses lossy consumers
contract: A numeric-key MAP contains an ARRAY of TUPLE values, including UInt128 above u64::MAX, a NULL tuple field, and an empty nested array.
Native toTypeName() and toJSONString() oracles match the driver value and JSON/CSV exports.
SQL literal rendering, parameter binding, and keyed grid editing refuse nested values without native type metadata; refusal leaves the stored row unchanged.
